svg.title: PEFT and Model Compression Architecture: LoRA, QLoRA, and Quantization
svg.desc: Architectural diagram illustrating Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA), post-training quantization (AWQ, GPTQ), and multi-adapter serving runtimes.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: PEFT & Model Compression Architecture: LoRA, QLoRA & Serving

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Low-Rank Decompositions (W = W0 + BA), 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4), Post-Training Quantization & Multi-Adapter Serving

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA & DoRA)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Low-Rank Decomposition W = W0 + (α/r)·BA

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Base weight W0 (d × k) is frozen; receives zero gradient updates

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Adapter matrices: A (r × k) initialized Gaussian, B (d × r) zeroed

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Efficiency: Rank r << min(d,k); trains <0.5% of total model weights

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DoRA: Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Decomposes weight matrix into magnitude m and direction V

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • W = m · (W0 + ΔW) / ||W0 + ΔW||; isolates directional updates

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Mirrors full fine-tuning weight trajectories with zero inference lag

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Benchmark: Consistently outperforms standard LoRA on reasoning tasks

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. QLoRA: 4-Bit Precision & Memory Mechanics

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NormalFloat4 (NF4) & Double Quantization

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • NF4: Information-theoretically optimal quantiles for normal weights

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Double Quantization: Quantizes the quantization constants (saves 0.37b/p)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hardware Unlock: Fine-tunes a 70B parameter LLM on a single 48GB GPU

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paged Optimizers (Preventing OOM Spikes)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Leverages CUDA Unified Memory to page memory between GPU & CPU

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Automatically evicts optimizer states during long-sequence peaks

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Forward/backward computation dequantizes NF4 to FP16 on the fly

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cost Impact: Reduces fine-tuning infrastructure costs by over 75%

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Post-Training Quantization (AWQ, GPTQ & FP8)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AWQ vs GPTQ Quantization Mechanics

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • AWQ: Protects salient 1% channels based on activation magnitudes

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • GPTQ: Uses second-order inverse Hessian H^-1 to minimize error

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • FP8 (E4M3 / E5M2): Native hardware acceleration on H100 / Blackwell

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Latency Win: Replaces memory-bandwidth bottleneck with INT4/FP8 compute

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: KV-Cache Quantization & 2:4 Structured Sparsity

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • KV Cache Quantization: Compresses Key-Value buffers from FP16 to FP8

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Expands concurrent serving context lengths by 2.5x–4x

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 2:4 Structured Sparsity: 2 zeroes per 4 weights for 2x Tensor Core speedup

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Target: High-throughput batch inference under strict VRAM caps

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Production Multi-Adapter Serving Topology

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Multi-Tenant Dynamic Adapter Swapping (vLLM / SGLang)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 1 Frozen 70B Base Model + 50 domain adapters (Legal, Medical, Code)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Each adapter consumes <100MB VRAM; swapped in sub-millisecond time

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Inbound request header specifies target adapter: "x-adapter-id: finance"

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Massive VRAM Savings: Eliminates running 50 isolated 140GB model instances

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Zero-Overhead Weight Merging

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • For dedicated single-tenant workloads, merge adapter before deployment

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • W_final = W0 + (α/r)·BA permanently computed and saved

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Zero latency overhead during inference; identical to full fine-tuned model

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Result: Fast training velocity paired with zero-penalty serving
